text:
Type: glass cone pendant lamp on chain
Use: light over a dining table, kitchen island or counter; dining room, kitchen, living room
Style: industrial, farmhouse, retro
Materials: opal white glass shade, dark grey metal socket cap, chain and ceiling cup
Colors: milky white, anthracite dark grey
Shape: wide faceted cone shade with a low peaked top and flat bottom edge, small cap with a loop hanging from a link chain, medium size, clean schoolhouse outline
Feel: nostalgic, crisp, sturdy, bright
Goes with: white walls, dark metal, wood tables, subway tiles; farmhouse, industrial or Scandinavian kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: LVNGEN
product.description: This lamp gives a pleasant light for dining and spreads a good directed light across your dining or bar table.
